sources.limitations: XPU disaggregated KV transfers incur one device-to-host-to-NIC staging hop.

sources.title: NIXL PR #2176, #2327 & #2328: GPUNetIO Cross-Chunk Contiguous READ Coalescing (8 MiB Cap) and Multi-Threaded UCX CPU Proxy for Expert Parallelism
sources.read_scope: src/plugins/gpunetio/gpunetio_backend.cpp, src/plugins/ucx/ucx_backend.cpp, and examples/device/ep/
sources.notes: Merges contiguous same-key GPUNetIO READs across the 512-input boundary up to 8 MiB (4096 -> 2 WQEs, 10.97 -> 23.03 GB/s, p99 1516 -> 726 us on 2xH20) and reaches 82.97/80.23 GB/s EP dispatch/combine on 16xGB200 via 8ch/8thr UCX CPU proxy.
sources.limitations: GPUNetIO coalescing applies only to contiguous same-key READs; WRITE and fragmented descriptors keep existing boundaries.
